title: Quarantined Tests Configuration
description: Tests that are known to be flaky and temporarily quarantined from failing CI

test.description: Test name or file path that matches the test output

owner.description: GitHub username or team responsible for fixing this test

ticket.description: Issue or ticket URL tracking the fix for this flaky test

evidence.description: Links to failed runs showing this test is flaky (same SHA failed then passed)

reason.description: Brief explanation of why this test is flaky

addedAt.description: Date when this test was quarantined (YYYY-MM-DD)
